name: JO-Bench
description:
JO-Bench: Jailbreak Oracle Benchmark
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

JO-Bench is a curated benchmark of harmful prompts used to evaluate LLM safety in the paper:

Toward Principled LLM Safety Testing: Solving the Jailbreak Oracle Problem

This dataset is not original work by the dataset authors. It is a combination of two existing public benchmarks:

We combine JailbreakBench (Chao et al., 2024) and the chemical/biological category from HarmBench (Mazeika et al., 2024), resulting in… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shuyilin/JO-Bench.
reputation: A recent, specialized compilation used by the safety research community for jailbreak evaluation; increasingly referenced in LLM safety work but not yet a universal standard.
